_doc: Every uncovered in-scope line/branch must be listed here WITH a justification. See docs/11_unit_testing.md section 'Uncovered code'.

lines.why: RequisitionUpdateView.get_success_url - only reached after a successful UI update POST, which is impossible on the baseline because of defect F14 (form_valid crashes on line 410). Becomes coverable when F14 is fixed.

Remainder of RequisitionUpdateView.form_valid after line 410, which always raises AttributeError (F14: cleaned_data read from an UNBOUND formset). Unreachable until F14 is fixed; behaviour is exercised via the JSON update API instead (UT107-UT114).

branches.why: Infeasible: `if errors:` in RequisitionCreateView - formset.errors only contains ErrorDicts whose fields have >=1 error, so the False edge cannot occur.
Infeasible: `if item_data.get('item')` - 'item' is a required ModelChoiceField, so every valid, non-deleted line has an item.
Infeasible: same `if errors:` pattern in IssueItemsView.post - form.errors never maps a field to an empty list.
